paite: TOUPA aw, ka dikna thu za inla, ka kikou husa ngaikhia inla, ka thumna, zuauthu genhat muk a pawt hilou ah, bil na doh in.
heading: David Thumna / Midiktat Thumna
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

paite: Ka tung a thupukna na ma a kipan a pawt hi henla; na mit in khentuam neihlouhna en hen.
english: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

paite: Ka lungtang na enchian a; zan in na hong pha a; na hon endikta a bangmah na mu het kei a; ka kam in agenkhial kei ding ka chi tinten ahi.
english: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

paite: Mihing thilhih ah zaw, na muk a thupawt ziak in mihing ngongtat lampi a pai lou ding in ka kikemhoih ahi.
english: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

paite: Ka kalsuante'n na lampi atawn ziahziah a, ka khete atal ngei kei hi.
english: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

paite: Pathian aw, ka hon sam zel a, nang lah na hon dawng ding a; kei lam ah na bil hon doh inla, ka thugen ngaikhia in.
english: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

paite: Nangmah a ginna koih peuhmahte kiang a, na khut taklam a amau sualte hondam zelpa aw, na zahngaihna lamdang kilangsak in.
english: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

paite: Mit nauta bang in hon kem inla, na kha nuai ah hon busak in.
english: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

paite: Migilou-salou hon hihsia a, hon dou a hon umkimvel lak ah.
english: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

paite: Amaute thau a um in a-om ua, akam un kisatheitak in thu agen uhi.
english: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

paite: Tu in ka kalsuanna peuhmah ahon umsuak a, hon hihpuk ding in amitte uh ka tung uah atusak uhi.
english: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

paite: Amah humpinelkai sa keih ut bang leh humpinelkai lun lai mundai peuh a buk nilouh bang ahi.
english: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

paite: TOUPA aw, thou inla, amah maituah pih inla, kunsak in; ka hinna migilou-salou lak ah na namsau in humbit in.
english: Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,

paite: TOUPA aw, na khut in mihingte lak ah, khovel mihingte lak ah, humbit in; amau tuam zaw tu damsung a aneih uh ahi a, agil uh na gou in na dimsak naknak a; tate lungkim huntak in anei ua, asum zat val uh atangekte uh a ding in asihsan zel uhi.
english: from men by your hand, Yahweh, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

paite: Ke'n zaw diktatna nei in na mel ka mu ding a; nangmah batna nei a ka hah chiang in ka lungkim hun mahmah ding hi.
english: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
